query: Georgia battery manufacturing imported materials tariff exposure

statements.text: effective March 12, 2025, the current administration reinstated 25% tariffs on global steel imports and increased tariffs on global aluminum imports to 25%. These measures significantly affect the battery manufacturing industry
A 30 percent baseline tariff on all Chinese goods compounded the impact on battery cells and pack components sourced from China.

The recent 25% tariff on imported steel has significant implications for battery manufacturing costs. The tariff has led to increased prices in anticipation of increased domestic demand and constrained supply.
Tariffs on Chinese-manufactured batteries and related components have escalated, with rates increasing from 7.5% to 25%.

A 93.5 percent tariff on Chinese graphite – the primary anode material in virtually all lithium-ion batteries – took effect, representing one of the most significant raw material tariffs in US manufacturing history.
Steel and copper tariffs of 50 percent added further cost pressure on pack housings, connectors, busbars, and wiring harnesses.
